provenance: SYNTHETIC ARCHETYPES - NOT MEASURED PEOPLE. Each case is a hex triplet constructed to match the canonical published description of that season (skin/hair/eye characteristics as described in the Sci\ART 12-tone literature). Agreement against this set measures whether the engine reproduces the textbook DEFINITION of each season. It does NOT measure agreement with trained human analysts on real photographs - that requires a labelled photo set, which is tracked separately in data/seasons/README.md. Do not describe results from this file as clinical or empirical validation.
